results.title: Measuring Attitudes Toward Plastics: A Cross-Cultural ...
results.content: plastics; biodegradable; pollution; surveys; questionnaires; cross-cultural adaptation; citizens; knowledge; awareness; behavior-change interventions. With this work, we make available an appropriate questionnaire to measure knowledge and awareness of plastic pollution in Italian-speaking people. Another major asset of our study is the rigor of the cross-cultural adaptation process, which included the contribution of a multidisciplinary group of experts and, above all, the active participation of citizens whose characteristics reflected those of the Italian population. Through a rigorous adaptation process, this study provides a questionnaire that can be used in Italian-speaking citizens to assess public attitudes and behaviors related to plastic use. results.title: A Pragmatic CDO's Field Guide to Data Quality — Part 2 — ...
results.content: We unpack a five-family taxonomy — business semantics & policy, identity/linkage (MDM), schema & pipeline, analytics & ML, governance & process — anchored in real-world outages. You’ll learn the signature failure modes (schema evolution gone wrong, CDC retractions, grain mismatches, missing consent flags), how to tag them for faster triage, and how to trace root cause with lineage so your post-mortems stop sounding like guesswork. * **Five Failure Families:** We catalog data quality failures into five families — (A) **Business Semantics & Policy**, (B) **Identity & Linkage (MDM)**, © **Technical Schema & Pipeline**, (D) **Analytics & ML**, (E) **Governance & Process** — with codes A1–A4, B1–B4, C1–C11, D1–D5, E1–E7. * **Symptom → Tag → Trace:** For each sub-code, we show how issues **surface** (symptoms like conflicting KPIs or duplicate records), how to **tag** incidents with the right code, and how to **trace** root cause via **data lineage**. Dr. Adnan Masood is an Engineer, Thought Leader, Author, AI/ML PhD, Stanford Scholar, Harvard Alum, Microsoft Regional Director, and STEM Robotics Coach.
